senses.gloss:
गर गर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 2. गॄ), swallowing;
(अस्), m. any drink, beverage, fluid; a noxious or
poisonous beverage; a factitious poison; an anti-
dote; sickness, disease; probably a peculiar kind of
disease attended with difficulty of swallowing (?),
dysphagia (?); N. of a son of Uśīnara; (अम्), n. a
kind of poison; the fifth of the eleven Karaṇas;
sprinkling, wetting (?); (आ), f. swallowing; N. of a
plant, = देवदाली-लता; (ई), f. a kind of grass,
Andropogon Serratus.
—गर-गिर्, ईर्, ईर्, ईर्, or
गर-गीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one who has swal-
lowed a noxious draught, poisoned
—गरगीर्णिन्,
ई, m., N. of a Ṛṣi.
—गर-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्,
removing poison or the disease called Gara, an anti-
dote; sanative, healthy; (अस्), m. a kind of basil,
Ocimum Sanctum, = कृष्णार्जक; another kind
of Ocimum, = वर्वर; (ई). f a kind of fish, com-
monly Garaï, the young of the Ophiocephalus Lata.
—गर-द, अस्, आ, अम्, poisoning, a poisoner; un-
wholesome, occasioning sickness; (अम्), n. poison.
—गर-दान, अम्, n. giving poison.
—गर-
व्रत, अस्, m. a peacock.
—गर-हन्, आ, m. the
plant Ocimum Sanctum.
—गरात्मक (˚र-आत्˚),
अम्, n. the seed of the plant Śobhāñjana or Hyper-
anthera Moringa.
—गराधिका (˚र-अध्˚), f. the
insect called Lākṣā or the red dye obtained from it.

गार गार, अस्, m., N. of a Sāman, com-
posed by Gara.

गरण, अम्, n. the act of swallowing; wetting,
sprinkling.
—गरण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, occupied in
swallowing.

गरल, अस्, अम्, m. n. poison; the venom of a
snake or venom in general; (अम्), n. a bundle of
grass or hay; a measure in general.
—गरलारि
(˚ल-अरि), इस्, m. an emerald; [cf. गरुडाङ्कित,
गरुडाश्मन्, गरुडोत्तीर्ण.]
गरलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, venomous, poisonous.
गरित, अस्, आ, अम्, poisoned.

गरभ गरभ, अस्, m. the fœtus or embryo,
= गर्भ.

गरागरी गरागरी, f. a kind of grass,
Andropogon Serratus, = खरा, गरी, अगरी.

गरिमन् गरिमन्, आ, m. (fr. गुरु), heavi-
ness, weight; one of the eight Siddhis or faculties
of Śiva (making himself heavy at will); importance,
dignity, venerableness; worth, excellence.

गरिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. fr. गुरु), heaviest,
excessively heavy; very venerable; worst; (अस्), m.,
N. of a man; also of an Asura.

गरीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. fr. गुरु), heavier,
very heavy, heaviest; weightier, greater; more
precious or valuable, dearer; highly venerable;
worse.
—गरीयस्-त्व, अम्, n. weight, importance.
गरु = गुरु in अगरु, q. v.

गरुड गरुड, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 2. गॄ,
to swallow, because Garuḍa was perhaps originally
identified with the all-consuming fire of the sun's
rays), N. of a mythical bird, the chief of the
feathered race, the enemy of the serpent-race, the
vehicle of Viṣṇu, and the son of Kaśyapa and
Vinatā, and elder brother of Aruṇa; (shortly after
his birth he frightened the gods by his brilliant
lustre; they supposed him to be Agni, and requested
his protection; when they discovered that he was
Garuḍa, they praised him as the highest being, and
called him fire and sun. Aruṇa, the charioteer of the
sun or the personified dawn, is said to be the younger
brother of Garuḍa. In some legends Svāhā, the
wife of Agni, takes the shape of a female Garuḍī, =
सु-पर्णी. With Jainas, Garuḍa is an attendant of the
sixteenth Arhat of the present Avasarpiṇī); a building
shaped like Garuḍa; N. of a peculiar military array;
N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa; N. of a Kalpa, the fourteenth
day of Brahmā.
—गरुड-ध्वज, अस्, m. an epi-
thet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa (whose symbol is Garuḍa).
—गरुड-पुराण, अम्, n., N. of the seventeenth
Purāṇa; [cf. गारुड.]
—गरुड-रुत, अम्, n. a
species of metre, having four lines to the stanza and
[]
sixteen syllables to each line.
—गरुड-वेगा, f., N.
of a plant.
—गरुडाग्रज (˚ड-अग्), अस्, m. having
Garuḍa for his elder brother, an epithet of Aruṇa,
the charioteer of the sun.
—गरुडाङ्क (˚ड-अङ्˚),
अस्, m. an epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa.
—गरु-
डाङ्कित^1 (˚ड-अङ्˚), अम्, n. an emerald; [cf. गरु-
डाश्मन्, गरुडोत्तीर्ण, गारुड, गारुत्मत.]
—गरुडार्ध (˚ड-अर्˚), अस्, m. (?), a kind of
arrow.
—गरुडाश्मन् (˚ड-अश्˚), आ, m. an emerald.
—गरुडोत्तीर्ण (ड-उत्˚), अम्, n. an emerald.
—गरुडोपनिषद् (˚ड-उप्˚), त्, f., N. of an
Upaniṣad.
[1] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161201. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/322, batch 303.

गरुड; Aruṇa is the elder (not ‘younger’)
brother, and Garuḍāgraja should be translated ‘elder
brother of Garuḍa.’

गारुड गारुड, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. गरुड), shaped
like the bird Garuḍa, coming from or relating to
Garuḍa; (ई), f., N. of a creeper [cf. पाताल-गरुडी];
(अम्), n. an emerald; gold; a Mantra or charm
against poison.
—गारुड-पुराण, अम्, n., N. of
the seventeenth Purāṇa relating the birth of Garuḍa
from Vinatā. It is doubtful whether a genuine Gā-
ruḍa-Purāṇa exists.

गरुत् गरुत्, त्, m. (said to be fr. 2. गॄ),
the wing of a bird.
—गरुत्-मत्, आन्, अती, अत् (in
the Veda only found in connection with सु-पर्ण),
feathered, winged; swallowing; (आन्), m. the bird
Garuḍa; a bird in general.
—गरुद्-योधिन्, ई, m.
a quail.
गरुल गरुल = गरुड.

गर्ग गर्ग, अस्, m. (said to be fr. 2. गॄ),
N. of an old sage, a descendant of Bharad-vāja and of
Aṅgiras; N. of an astronomer; N. of a physician;
N. of a son of king Vitatha; also of a grandson of
this king; a bull; an earth-worm; (आस्), m. pl. the
descendants of Garga; (आ), f., N. of a woman; (ई),
f., N. of a woman; [cf. गार्गी and गार्ग्य.]
—गर्ग-
भूमि, इस्, m., N. of a prince; (also भर्ग-भूमि.)
—गर्ग-शिरस्, आस्, m., N. of a Dānava.
—गर्ग-
स्रोतस्, अस्, n. Garga's stream, N. of a Tīrtha.

गार्ग गार्ग, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. गार्ग्य below,
which is derived fr. गर्ग), coming from or con-
nected with Gārgya; a contemptuous metronymic
from Gārgī.
गर्गीय, अस्, m. a descendant of Garga (?).

1. गार्गीय, nom. P. गार्गीयति, to act like a
Gārgya; A. गार्गीयते, to behave like a Gārgya.

2. गार्गीय, अस्, आ, अम्, composed by Garga; com-
ing from Gārgya; (आस्), m. pl. the pupils of the
descendants of Garga; the pupils of Gārgyāyaṇa.

गर्गर गर्गर, अस्, m. (an onomatopoetic
word), a whirlpool, an eddy [cf. Lat. gurges]; a
kind of musical instrument; a kind of fish, Pime-
lodus Gagora; N. of a man; (अस्, ई), m. f. a churn;
a vessel for holding water, a guglet.

गर्गरक, अस्, m. a kind of fish [cf. the pre-
ceding]; a kind of plant with a poisonous root.

गर्गाट, अस्, m. a kind of fish, Pimelodus Gagora;
[cf. the preceding.]

गर्ज् गर्ज्, cl. 1. 10. P. गर्जति, जगर्ज,
गर्जिष्यति, अगर्जीत्, गर्जितुम्, गर्ज-
यति, -यितुम्, to emit a deep or full sound, to sound
as distant thunder, to thunder; to roar, growl; to
rave &c.; [cf. Lat. garrio, gurges; Old Germ.
kurran, krago, kragil, krachôn, gellan, kallôn,
kallari; Mod. Germ. quarren, girren.]

गर्ज, अस्, m. a (roaring) elephant; (अस्, आ), m. f.
the roaring of elephants, the rumbling of clouds &c.
—गर्जा-फल, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = वि-कण्टक.

गर्जक, अस्, m. a kind of fish, = शाल or शालज,
commonly गजाड.

गर्जन, अम्, n. sound, noise; crying, roaring,
the rumbling of clouds &c.; a grumbling noise, a
growl, a grunt; passion, wrath; war, battle, conflict;
excessive indignation, reproach, menace.
गर्जनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sounded or roared.
गर्जन्-मेघ, अस्, m. a thunder-cloud.

गर्जि, इस्, m. the muttering of clouds or distant
thunder.
गर्ज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be roared or sounded.

गर्त 1. गर्त, अस्, m., Ved. a high seat (?),
a throne; the seat of a war-chariot, a chariot; a
table for playing at dice; a house.
—गर्त-सद्, त्,
त्, त्, Ved. sitting on a war-chariot.
—गर्तारुह् (˚त-
आर्˚), क्, क्, क्, Ved. ascending a war-chariot; (Sāy.)
entering a hall of justice.

गर्त 2. गर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. (said to be
fr. rt. 2. गॄ, but perhaps a later form for कर्त),
a hollow, a hole, a cave; a grave; (अस्), m. the
hollow of the loins; a kind of disease; N. of a
country, a part of Trigarta, in the north-west of
[]
India.
—गर्तन्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having holes
or excavations.
—गर्त-मित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. buried in
a hole.
—गर्ताश्रय (˚त-आश्˚), अस्, m. any animal
living in holes or under ground, a mouse, rat, &c.
—गर्तेश (˚त-ईश), अस्, m. the master of a cave.
—गर्ते-ष्ठा, आस्, आस्, अम्, being in a hole or grave.

गर्तिका, f. a weaver's workshop (so called because
a weaver sits at his loom with his feet in a hole
below the level of the floor).

गर्द् गर्द्, cl. 1. 10. P. गर्दति, -दितुम्,
गर्दयति, -यितुम्, to sound, to roar, emit
any sound.

गर्दभ, अस्, m. (said to be fr. the last), an
ass; a kind of perfume, = गन्ध, smell, odour;
N. of a dynasty; (ई), f. a she-ass; an insect, a kind
of beetle generated in cow-dung; N. of a several
plants, = अपराजिता, कटभी, श्वेत-कण्टकारी; a
disease of the skin, an eruption of round, red, and
painful spots; also गर्दभिका; (अम्), n. the white
esculent water-lily, Nymphæa Esculenta; a kind of
plant used as a vermifuge; [cf. विडङ्ग].
—गर्द-
भ-गद, अस्, m. a kind of disease of the skin; [cf.
गर्दभिका, जाल-गर्दभ, ज्वाला-गर्दभक,
पाषाण-गर्दभ.]
—गर्दभ-नादिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
Ved. braying like an ass.
—गर्दभ-रूप, अस्, m.
having the form of an ass, an epithet of Vikramāditya.
—गर्दभ-शाक, अस्, आ or ई. m. f. the plant Cle-
rodendrum Siphonanthus.
—गर्दभाक्ष (भ-
अक्˚), अस्, m., N. of a descendant of Hiraṇya-kaśipu
and son of Bali.
—गर्दभाजिन (˚भ-अज्˚), अम्,
n. the skin or hide of an ass.
—गर्दभाण्ड (˚भ-
अण्˚), अस्, m., N. of a tree, commonly Pārspīpal,
Thespesia Populneoides; or also the tree Ficus
Infectoria; an Adhyāya or Anuvāka, in which the
word Gardabhāṇḍa occurs.
—गर्दभाण्डक, अस्,
m. the tree Thespesia Populneoides.
—गर्द-
भाण्डीय, अस्, m. an Adhyāya or Anuvāka, in
which the word Gardabhāṇḍa occurs.
—गर्द-
भाह्वय (˚भ-आह्˚), अम्, n. the white esculent
water-lily, Nymphæa Esculenta.
—गर्दभी-मु-
ख, अस्, m., N. of a preceptor.
—गर्दभी-विपीत,
अस्, m., N. of a man.

गर्दभक, अस्, m. a kind of insect; (इका), f. a
cutaneous disease, a blotch, an eruption.
गर्दभि, इस्, m., N. of a man.
गर्दभिन्, ई, m., N. of a dynasty; [cf. गर्दभ.]

गर्दयित्नु गर्दयित्नु, उस्, m. a cloud; [cf.
गडयत् and गडयित्नु.]
गर्ध् गर्ध्, another form of rt. गृध्.

गर्ध, अस्, m. desire, greediness, eagerness; a tree,
commonly called Pārspīpal; [cf. गर्दभाण्ड.]

गर्धन or गर्धित, अस्, आ, अम्, covetous,
greedy.

गर्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, desirous, greedy, covetous;
pursuing or following with eagerness.

गर्ब् 1. गर्ब्, cl. 1. P. गर्बति, -बितुम्, to
move, to go or approach, = खर्ब्, चर्ब्,
घर्ब्, &c.
गर्ब् 2. गर्ब्. See गर्व् and गर्व.

गर्भ गर्भ, अस्, m. (fr. ग्रभ् = ग्रह्, to
conceive, said to be fr. 2. गॄ), the womb, the belly,
the inside, the middle, the interior of anything; an
inner apartment, a lying-in chamber; any interior
chamber, the adytum of a temple &c.; a fœtus or
embryo, a child, the brood or offspring of birds; the
fruit (of plants); the offspring of the sky, i. e. the
fogs and vapour drawn upwards by the rays of the
sun during eight months and sent down again in
the rainy season; the bed of a river (especially of the
Ganges) when fullest, i. e. on the fourteenth day of
the dark half of the month Bhadrā, or in the height
of the rains, (the Garbha extends to this point, after
which the Tīra or proper bank begins, and extends
for 150 cubits; this space being holy ground);
joining, union; the rough coat of the fruit of the
[]
Jaka; the calyx of the lotus. (गर्भ is often found
at the end of compounds in the sense of having in
the interior, containing, filled with; e. g. जल-गर्-
भ, अस्, आ, अम्, filled with water; अग्नि-गर्भ, अस्,
आ, अम्, containing fire); [cf. अमृत-गर्भ, अर्ध-
ग्˚, कृष्ण-ग्˚, मूढ-ग्˚, विश्व-ग्˚, हिरण्य-ग्˚:
cf. also Hib. cilfin, ‘the belly;’ Angl. Sax. hrif;
Germ. kalb (?); Eng. calf; Gr. δελφός.]
—गर्भ-
कर, अस्, ई, अम्, producing impregnation, procrea-
tive, fecundatory, impregnatory; (अस्), m. the plant
Nageia Putrañjīva.
—गर्भ-करण, अम्, n., Ved.
anything which causes impregnation.
—गर्भ-
कार, अस्, आ, अम्, impregnating, fecundatory, pro-
creative, producing impregnation; (अम्), n., N. of
a ceremony.
—गर्भ-काल, अस्, m. the time of
impregnation; the time when the offspring of the
sky, i. e. the vapour collected in the air [cf. गर्भ
above], shows the first signs of life, 195 days or seven
lunar months after its first conception.
—गर्भ-
कोश or गर्भ-कोष, अस्, m. the uterus.
—गर्भ-
क्लेश, अस्, m. pains caused by the embryo, pains of
childbirth.
—गर्भ-क्षय, अस्, m. loss of the
embryo, miscarriage.
—गर्भ-गृह, अम्, n. an
inner apartment, an inner chamber, a lying-in cham-
ber; the sanctuary or adytum of a temple; (in
compounds) a house containing anything (e. g. शर-
गर्भ-गृह, a house containing arrows).
—गर्भ-
ग्रहण, अम्, n. conception, impregnation.
—गर्-
भ-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, killing the embryo, producing
abortion; (इनी), f. a poisonous plant, Methonica Su-
perba.
—गर्भ-चलन, अम्, n. quickening, the mo-
tion of the fœtus in the uterus.
—गर्भ-च्युत, अस्,
आ, अम्, fallen from the womb (as a child); miscarrying.
—गर्भ-च्युति, इस्, f. falling from the womb, birth,
delivery; miscarriage.
—गर्भ-ता, f. or गर्भ-
त्व, अम्, n. impregnation.
—गर्भ-द, अस्, आ, अम्,
impregnating, procreative; (अस्), m. the tree Nageia
Putrañjīva; (आ), f., N. of a shrub.
—गर्भ-दातृ,
ता, त्री, तृ, impregnating, procreative; (ई), f., N. of
a shrub, = गर्भ-दा, अपत्य-दा, पुत्र-दा, &c.
—गर्भ-दास, अस्, m. a slave by birth.
—गर्भ-
दिवस, आस्, m. pl. certain days on which the vapours
collected in the air show signs of life; [cf. गर्भ-
काल.]
—गर्भ-द्रुह्, -ध्रुक्, क्, क्, destroying
the fœtus, causing abortion.
—गर्भ-ध, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. procreative, impregnatory.
—गर्भ-
धरा, f. bearing a fœtus, pregnant.
—गर्भ-
धान, अम्, n. impregnating.
—गर्भ-धारण,
अम्, आ, n. f. gestation, impregnation, conception in the
womb, pregnancy; N. of the twenty-second Adhyāya in
Varāha-mihira's Bṛhat-saṃhitā.
—गर्भ-धारित,
अस्, आ, अम्, contained in the womb, conceived, borne.
—गर्भ-धि, इस्, m., Ved. a breeding-place, a nest,
cohabitation.
—गर्भ-ध्वंस, अस्, m. abortion.
—गर्भ-नाडी or गर्भ-नाभि-नाडी, f. the
umbilical cord.
—गर्भ-नुद्, त्, त्, त्, causing abor-
tion; (त्), m. the poisonous plant Methonica Superba.
—गर्भ-परिस्रव, अस्, m. secundines.
—गर्भ-
पाकिन्, ई, m. rice ripening in sixty days (during the
latter period of the sky's pregnancy).
—गर्भ-पात,
अस्, m. miscarriage after the fourth month of preg-
nancy.
—गर्भ-पातक, अस्, ई, अम्, causing mis-
carriage; (अस्), m. a red kind of Moringa.
—गर्-
भ-पातन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing miscarriage, pro-
ducing abortion; (अस्), m., N. of a plant, = रीठा-
करञ्ज; (ई), f. the plant Methonica Superba; any
plant or drug supposed to produce abortion; (अम्),
n. producing abortion.
—गर्भ-पातिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
causing miscarriage, producing abortion; (इनी), f., N.
of a plant, = विशल्या.
—गर्भ-पोषण, अम्, n.
nourishing a fœtus, gestation.
—गर्भ-भर्मन्,
अ, n. supporting a fœtus, gestation.
—गर्भ-
भवन, अम्, n. the sanctuary or adytum of a
temple; [cf. गर्भ-गृह.]
—गर्भ-भार, अस्,
m. the weight of the fœtus.
—गर्भ-मण्डप, अस्,
m. an inner apartment, a bed-chamber.
—गर्भ-
मास, अस्, m. month of pregnancy.
—गर्भ-मो-
चन, अम्, n. delivery, birth.
—गर्भ-योषा, f. a
pregnant woman, metaphorically the river Ganges
overflowing its banks.
—गर्भ-रक्षण, अम्, n.
protecting the fœtus, N. of a ceremony performed
[]
in the fourth month of gestation.
—गर्भ-रन्धि,
इस्, f. complete cooking (?).
—गर्भ-रस, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. endowed with impregnating moisture.
—गर्-
भ-रूप or गर्भ-रूपक, अस्, आ, अम्, childish,
juvenile; (अस्), m. a child, an infant, a youth.
—गर्भ-लक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, observing the
signs of the rainy season; (अम्), n. symptom of preg-
nancy; N. of the twenty-first Adhyāya of Varāha-mi-
hira's Bṛhat-saṃhitā treating on the marks or signs
of the rainy season.
—गर्भ-लम्भन, अम्, n.
a ceremony performed for the sake of facilitating
conception.
—गर्भ-वती, f. a pregnant female.
—गर्भ-वसति, इस्, f. or गर्भ-वास, अस्, m.
the abode of the fœtus, the womb.
—गर्भ-वायु,
उस्, m. air in the womb.
—गर्भ-विच्युति, इस्, f.
abortion in the beginning of pregnancy.
—गर्भ-
विपत्ति, इस्, f. the death of the fœtus.
—गर्भ-
वेदना, f. the pains of childbirth.
—गर्भ-
वेश्मन्, अ, n. the womb or a lying-in chamber.
—गर्भ-व्याकरण, अम्, n. the formation of
the embryo, a part of the Śarīra section in medical
works.
—गर्भ-व्यापद्, त्, f. the death of the
fœtus.
—गर्भ-व्यूह, अस्, m. a kind of battle
array.
—गर्भ-शङ्कु, उस्, m. a kind of vectis or
instrument for extracting the dead fœtus.
—गर्भ-
शय्या, f. the abode of the fœtus, the uterus.
—गर्-
भ-सङ्क्रमण, अम्, n. entering the womb.
—गर्भ-समय, अस्, m. the time when the
offspring of the sky, the vapour collected in the air,
shows the first signs of life, 195 days or seven lunar
months after its conception; [cf. गर्भ-काल.]
—गर्भ-सम्भव, अस्, m. or गर्भ-सम्भूति,
इस्, f. the production of a fœtus, the becoming preg-
nant.
—गर्भ-सुभग or गर्भ-सौभाग्य,
अस्, आ, अम्, blessing the fœtus.
—गर्भ-सूत्र, अम्,
n. title of a Buddhist Sūtra work.
—गर्भ-स्थ,
अस्, आ, अम्, situated in the womb; centrical, internal,
in the interior, within the centre of anything.
—गर्भ-स्राव, अस्, m. abortion, miscarriage.
—गर्भस्राविन्, ई, इणी, इ, producing or occasion-
ing abortion; (ई), m. the tree Phœnix Paludosa
(हिन्ताल).
—गर्भागार (˚भ-आग्˚), अम्, n. the
uterus; an inner and private room, the female apart-
ments, the lying-in chamber; the sanctuary of a
temple, the chamber where the object of worship or
the image of a deity is placed; [cf. गर्भ-गृह.]
—गर्भाङ्क (˚भ-अङ्˚), अस्, m. interlude during
an act.
—गर्भाद (˚भ-अद), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
consuming the fœtus.
—गर्भाधान (˚भ-आध्˚),
अम्, n. impregnation; a ceremony performed after
menstruation to ensure or facilitate conception.
—गर्भावक्रान्ति (˚भ-अव्˚), इस्, f. descent of the
fœtus.
—गर्भाशङ्का (˚भ-आश्˚), f. suspicion of
pregnancy.
—गर्भाशय (˚भ-आश्˚), अस्, m. the
womb, the uterus.
—गर्भाष्टम (˚भ-अष्˚), अस्,
m. the eighth month of uterine gestation; the eighth
year reckoning from conception.
—गर्भास्पन्दन
(˚भ-अस्प्˚), अम्, n. non-quickening of the fœtus.
—गर्भास्राव (˚भ-आस्˚), अस्, m. miscarriage.
—गर्भे-तृप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, contented in the womb,
i. e. indolent.
—गर्भेश्वर (˚भ-ईश्˚), अस्, m. a
sovereign by birth.
—गर्भेश्वर-ता, f. sovereignty
attained by inheritance.
—गर्भोत्पत्ति (˚भ-उत्˚),
इस्, f. the formation of the embryo.
—गर्भो-
पघात (˚भ-उप्˚), अस्, m. miscarriage of the em-
bryo, (applied also to the sky.)
—गर्भोपघातिनी
(˚भ-उप्˚), f. a cow (or female) miscarrying from
unseasonable gestation.
—गर्भोपनिषद् (˚भ-
उप्˚), त्, f. title of an Upaniṣad.

गार्भ गार्भ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. गर्भ), born
from the womb; fetal, uterine; relating to or con-
nected with gestation, also to conception (as any act
or ceremony).

गर्भक, अस्, m. a chaplet of flowers &c. worn
in the hair; (अम्), n. a period of two nights with
the intermediate day.
गर्भित, अस्, आ, अम्, pregnant, full, filled.

गर्भिन्, ई, इणी, इ, pregnant, impregnated with
(with acc. or inst.); (इणी), f. pregnant, a pregnant
woman or animal; compounded with names of
animals (e. g. गो-गर्भिणी, a pregnant cow).
—गर्भिणी-व्याकरण, अम्, n. or गर्भिणी-
व्याकृति, इस्, f. ‘science of the progress of preg-
nancy,’ a particular head or subject in medical
works.
—गर्भिण्य्-अवेक्षण, अम्, n. midwifery,
[]
attendance and care of pregnant women and new-
born infants.

गर्भण्ड गर्भण्ड, अस्, m. (fr. गर्भ and
अण्ड?), enlargement of the navel.

गर्मुटिका गर्मुटिका, f. a species of rice;
[cf. गर्मूच्छद.]

गर्मुत् गर्मुत्, त्, f. (said to be fr. rt. 2. गॄ),
a kind of bee [cf. गार्मुत]; a kind of grass; a
creeper; a kind of reed (नड); according to some
authorities the plant Vangueria Spinosa, commonly
Mayanā; according to others Coix Barbata, com-
monly Gaḍagaḍa; gold.

गर्मूच्छद गर्मूच्छद, अस्, m. and गर्मू-
टिका, f. a kind of rice, commonly Māḍuyā, Eleusine
Coracana; [cf. गर्मुटिका.]

गर्मोटिका गर्मोटिका, f. a species of reed,
= जरडी.

गर्व् गर्व् or गर्ब्, cl. 1. P., 10. A. गर्-
वति, -वितुम्, गर्वयते, -यितुम्, to be
or become proud or haughty; [cf. Lith. garbê,
‘honour, glory;’ Old Germ. gelban, gelf.]
गर्व or गर्ब, अस्, m. pride, arrogance.
गर्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, proud, haughty, arrogant.

गर्वाय, nom. A. गर्वायते, -यितुम्, to show
pride or arrogance.
गर्वित, अस्, आ, अम्, proud, haughty; conceited.

गर्वण गर्वण, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N.
of a rock.

गर्वाट गर्वाट, अस्, m. a watchman, a door-
keeper, a sort of village constable, a head-borough
or beadle.

गर्ह् गर्ह्, cl. 1. 10. P. A. गर्हति, -ते,
गर्हयति, -ते, जगर्ह, जगर्हे, गर्-
हिष्यते, अगर्हिष्ट, गर्हितुम्, to lodge a com-
plaint before a person (dat.), accuse, charge with,
reproach, blame, censure a person (acc.); to be sorry
for, repent of: Desid. जिगर्हिषते, -ति: Intens.
जागर्ह्यते, जागर्ड्ढि.

गर्हण, अम्, आ, n. f. censuring, censure, blame,
reproach; गर्हणां या, to meet with reproach.

गर्हणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, censurable, blamable, con-
temptible, vile, bad.
गर्हा, f. abuse, censure, reproach.

गर्हित, अस्, आ, अम्, blamed, censured; con-
temned, despised; contemptible, ignominious, for-
bidden, bad, vile.
गर्हितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be censured, blamable.
गर्हिन्, ई, इणी, इ, abusing, reproaching.

गर्ह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, deserving reproach, con-
temptible, low, vile; (अस्), m., N. of a tree (?).
—गर्ह्य-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, speaking ill, speaking
vilely or inaccurately.
गार्ह्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. गृह), domestic.

गारित्र गारित्र, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 2. गॄ), rice,
corn, grain.
गारुडिक, अस्, m. a charmer, a dealer in antidotes.

गारुत्मत गारुत्मत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. गरुत्-
मत्), shaped like the bird Garuḍa, sacred to Garuḍa
&c.; (अम्), n. an emerald; [cf. गरुडाङ्कित, &c.]
—गारुत्मत-पत्त्रिका, f., N. of a plant; [cf.
पाची and मरकत-पत्त्री.]

गार्गक, अस्, इका, अम्, belonging to Gārgya,
worshipping Gārgya; (अम्), n. a multitude or assem-
blage of the descendants of Garga.

गार्गिक, अस्, m. a metronymic from Gārgī, ex-
pressing contempt.

गार्गिका, f. descent from Garga, the relation to
the school of Gārgya.

गार्गी, f. the wife of Gārgya; an epithet of Durgā.
—गार्गी-पुत्र, अस्, m. the son of Gārgī; N. of a
teacher.
—गार्गीपुत्रकायणि or गार्गीपुत्रायणि or
गार्गीपुतृ, इस्, m. a descendant of the son of Gārgī.

गार्गी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has become a
Gārgya.
गार्गेय, अस्, m. a metronymic from Gārgī.

गार्ग्य, अस् (f. गी), अम्, descended from Garga, as
a son or daughter; (अस्), m., N. of several teachers of
grammar, of the ritual, &c.; according to Durga, a
Gārgya is the author of the Pada-pāṭha of the Sāma-
veda; N. of a king of the Gandharvas; N. of a
people.
—गार्ग्य-परिशिष्ट, अम्, n. title of a Pari-
śiṣṭa of the Atharva-veda.

गार्ग्यायण, अस्, m. a patronymic from Gārgya,
N. of a teacher; (ई), f. = गार्गी.
गार्ग्यायणीय, आस्, m. pl. the pupils of Gārgyāyaṇa.

गार्त्समद गार्त्समद, अस्, m. a patronymic
from Gṛtsa-mada; (अम्), n., N. of a Sāman.

गार्दभरथिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. गर्दभ-
रथ), fit for a donkey-cart.

गार्द्ध्य गार्द्ध्य, अम्, n. (fr. गृद्ध, rt.
गृध्), desire, greediness.

गार्ध्र (or wrongly spelt गार्ध), अस्, ई, अम्
(fr. गृध्र), derived from a vulture, vulturous, vul-
turine; rapacious, greedy (?); (अस्), m. an arrow;
desire, greediness, cupidity (in the latter sense the
word गार्ध्र is probably a wrong reading for
गार्द्ध्य).
—गार्ध्र-पक्ष, or गार्ध्र-पत्-
त्र, or गार्ध्र-वाजित, or गार्ध्र-राजित, अस्, आ,
अम् (?), or गार्ध्र-वासस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, decorated
with vulture's feathers (especially an arrow so deco-
rated); [cf. गृध्र-वाज and गृध्र-वाजित.]

गार्भिक, अस्, ई, अम्, fetal, uterine; relating to or
connected with gestation or the fœtus in the womb.

गार्भिण, अम्, n. (fr. गर्भिणी), a number or
assemblage of pregnant women.

गार्भिण्य, अम्, n. an assemblage of pregnant
women.
गार्मुत गार्मुत, अम्, n. (fr. गर्मुत्), honey (?).

गार्ष्टेय गार्ष्टेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. गृष्टि),
Ved. born from a heifer.

गार्हपत गार्हपत, अम्, n. (fr. गृह-पति),
the position and dignity of a householder.

गार्हपत्य, अस्, m., scil. अग्नि, a sacred fire, per-
petually maintained by a householder, received from
his father and transmitted to his descendants, and
from which fires for sacrificial purposes are lighted;
the place where this sacred fire is kept; (आस्), m. pl.,
N. of a class of manes; (अम्), n. the government
of a family, position of a householder, a household.
—गार्हपत्यागार (˚य-आग्˚), अस्, m. the place in
which the Gārhapatya fire is kept.

गार्हमेध, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. गृह-मेध), fit
or proper for a householder.

गार्हस्थ्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. गृह-स्थ), fit for
or incumbent on a householder; (अम्), n. the order
or estate of a householder, of the father or mother of
a family; household, domestic affairs, the house with
its contents.
